notes: Conditional Access now flags named locations that aren't doing anything: a country list referenced by no enabled policy (the geo-restriction isn't actually enforced) or an unused IP/trusted location. They appear in Policy hygiene / Findings, so you can wire them into a policy or remove them.
Removed the read-only Infrastructure tab — it didn't drive action; the useful signal is now the finding above.
Run a backup on demand, restore any snapshot, and edit the daily/weekly schedule from Conditional Access → Backup & Restore.
